table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Date=H.Date, 
	ServicePurInvCode=H.ServicePurInvCode, 
	SuppCode=H.SuppCode, 
	Supplier = A.Name, 
	RegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM ServiceHeader SH, Patient P 
			WHERE SH.ServiceInvCode=H.ServiceInvCode AND 
			P.PatientCode IN (CASE WHEN SH.PatientCode > 0 THEN SH.PatientCode
			ELSE (SELECT PA.PatientCode FROM PatientAdmission PA WHERE PA.AdmissionCode = SH.AdmissionCode)
			END)),
	Patient = (SELECT P.Name FROM ServiceHeader SH, Patient P 
			WHERE SH.ServiceInvCode=H.ServiceInvCode AND 
			P.PatientCode IN (CASE WHEN SH.PatientCode > 0 THEN SH.PatientCode
			ELSE (SELECT PA.PatientCode FROM PatientAdmission PA WHERE PA.AdmissionCode = SH.AdmissionCode)
			END)),
	Posted=H.Posted, 
	InvTotal=H.InvTotal, 
	OutstandingAmt=H.OutstandingAmt,
	Service=SV.Name,
	Share = D.Qty * D.Price,
	RowID=D.RowID,
	NetAmount = D.Qty * (D.Price - D.ServiceFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01),
	ReturnAmt = ISNULL((SELECT SR.InvTotal
			FROM ServicePRHeader SR
			WHERE SR.ServicePurInvCode = H.ServicePurInvCode), 0),
	PaidAmt = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(GD.Debit)
			FROM VocherCategory VC, GLHeader GL, GLDetail GD
			WHERE VC.InvoiceType=4 AND 
				VC.VochCatCode = GL.VochCatCode AND 
				GL.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND GD.InvoiceCode = H.ServicePurInvCode), 0)
FROM ServicePurHeader H, ServicePurDetail D, Supplier S, Accounts A, Service SV
WHERE 
	H.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
	H.SuppCode IN (:ai_suppcode) AND
	H.ServicePurInvCode = D.ServicePurInvCode AND
	H.SuppCode = S.SuppCode AND
	S.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
	D.ServiceCode = SV.ServiceCode
table.sort: supplier A, servicepurinvcode A, rowid A
